question: In the central composite design for α-terpineol enrichment, what α-terpineol content was obtained in the run at 150 Pa, 30 °C and 2 mL/min?
rendered:
<document title="Green enrichment of α-terpineol from niaouli oil residue via molecular distillation">

=== page 1 ===
- The optimal conditions were determined to be 209.7 Pa, 35.4 °C, and 1.39 mL min^−1, resulting in an a-terpineol content of 70.97% with a recovery rate of 89.2%.

=== page 2 ===
- Experi-ments were conducted at a rotor (wiper) speed of 250 rpm and a condenser temperature of 2 °C. Three operating variables were investigated: absolute pressure (Pa), evaporator surface temperature (°C), and feed ow rate (mL min^−1).

=== page 3 ===
- Separation was achieved on an HP-5MS capillary column (30 m × 0.25 mm i.d., 0.25 mm lm thickness; Agilent).
- Helium was used as the carrier gas at a ow rate of 1.2 mL min^−1, with a split ratio of 1 :
- 100. The injector and ion source temperatures were set at 250 °C and 230 °C, respectively. The oven temperature was pro-grammed from 60 to 240 °C at 3.0 °C min^−1, then increased to
- 270 °C at 5.0 °C min^−1 and held for 2 min.

=== page 4 ===
- Mass spectra were acquired in electron ionization (EI) mode at 70 eV over a mass range of 50–550 amu with a scan rate of 1 scan per s.
- In particular, a-terpineol was identied with a high match factor (MF = 905), indicating excellent spectral agreement.
- Quantitative analysis by GC-FID. a-Terpineol was quantied using a gas chromatography-ame ionization detection (GC-FID) system (GC-2030, Shimadzu, Japan) equipped with an SH-I-5MS capillary column (30 m × 0.25 mm i.d., 0.25 mm lm thickness).

=== page 5 ===
- Samples were diluted 100-fold with hexane and injected in split mode (1 : 100).
- Nitrogen was used as the carrier gas at a ow rate of 1.2 mL min^−1.
- The injector temperature was set at 250 °C. The oven temperature was programmed from 60 to 240 °C at 3.0 °C min^−1, then increased to 270 °C at 5.0 ° C min^−1 and held for 2 min.

=== page 7 ===
- The optimal operating conditions for enhancing a-terpineol content were identied as a pressure of 209.7 Pa, an evaporator surface temperature of 35.4 °C, and a feed ow rate of 1.39 mL min^−1, with a predicted value of 70.89%.

Answer: The α-terpineol content obtained in the run at 150 Pa, 30 °C and 2 mL/min is 65.92%.
